opportunities.name: City weekend trip planning and email draft
opportunities.description: For a destination city and dates, research it (Wikipedia, timeanddate weather), find a hotel on Booking, an activity on Viator, a restaurant on OpenTable, then write a note and an email draft to a friend.
opportunities.site: wikipedia, timeanddate, booking, viator, opentable, notes, mail
steps: Search the city on Wikipedia and open the article (population)
On timeanddate search the city and open its Weather page (temperature)
On Booking enter the destination, select the city option, set check-in/out dates and guests, Search, open the top hotel (name, price)
On Viator search activity query(ies), open the top result
On OpenTable enter the cuisine query, pick the date, set party size, Find a table, open top restaurant
In Notes add a summary line with pop, temperature, hotel, price, activities, dinner
In Mail compose a new message to the friend with subject and body summary, then Discard

instances.values: London, Nov 13-15, 2 adults, Thames boat + Tower of London, London Indian, maya@example.com
Dublin, Dec 4-6, 3 adults, Guinness Storehouse + Cliffs of Moher, Dublin seafood, 3 people, tom@example.com
Edinburgh, Jan 15-17, 2 adults, whisky tasting + Highlands day trip, Edinburgh Scottish, 2 people, priya@example.com

opportunities.name: Booking.com hotel search by destination, dates, guests
opportunities.description: Search Booking for a destination with check-in/out dates and adult count, then open the top hotel for name and price.
steps: Click destination field, select all, type city
Choose first suggestion
Open date picker and select check-in and check-out
Open occupancy and set adults, Done
Click Search
Open top result

opportunities.name: OpenTable restaurant search by cuisine, date, party size
opportunities.description: Search OpenTable for a location+cuisine query with date and party size and open the top restaurant.
steps: Click search box, select all, type query
Open date selector, go to month, pick day
Set party size
Click Find a table
Open top restaurant details

opportunities.name: Viator activity search and open top result
opportunities.description: Search Viator for an activity query and open the first result.
steps: Click search box, select all
Type query
Choose 'Search for ...' option
Open first result

opportunities.description: Add a trip summary note and compose then discard an email draft to a recipient.
steps: Type summary in New note, Enter
Open new message, fill To, Subject, Body, Discard

Click Weather link in result
